structured.answer: It's worth it because the employer adds money on top of my salary (up to 7.5%, me 2.5%), and after 6 years (3 at retirement age or for a course) I can take it out without tax. But I couldn't tell from the page whether the money can go down, so I'll ask the bank clerk or my son which option to pick.
